name: Velvoite
description: Monitor EU financial regulation directly from Claude. Velvoite tracks 2,400+ regulatory documents across EUR-Lex, EBA, ESMA, EIOPA, FIN-FSA, and BaFin — extracting 16,000+ specific obligations with deadlines, entity scope, and enforcement decisions. Set your company's regulatory profile once, then query obligations filtered to your exact roles. Every answer includes verbatim legal text and a link to the official source.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Velvoite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Velvoite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.velvoite.eu/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Velvoite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Velvoite lists 14 MCP tools, including get_stats, get_company_profile, get_obligations, get_obligation_summary, get_deadlines, get_actor_roles, list_documents, get_document, search_regulations, get_recent_changes, get_enforcement_decisions, and get_verification_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Velvoite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Velvoite in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Velvoite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Velvoite is developed by Silly Pilot Oy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
